title: Fast, Aero, and 2.2″ Tires: Meet the New Factor Elara Gravel Bike
content:
2.2-inch tires and a short chainstay shouldn't be possible. We talked with Factor to learn how the team made it happen through clever carbon manufacturing and why a TeXtreme carbon downtube was needed.

Read the full article at Fast, Aero, and 2.2″ Tires: Meet the New Factor Elara Gravel Bike on Velo.
author: Josh Ross
